scope: Follow-up cleanup of AF.4 deferred TopK dynamic-gradient scale work

resolved.finding: TopK input_scale_vec and persistent scale attributes are redundant on the forward-hook RNN path
resolved.notes: TopK input-scale computation was removed because no TopK input hook consumes it. Forward-hook registration now captures scale tensors in per-forward hooks without mutating persistent param_scale_vec/input_scale_vec attributes. The legacy non-forward-hook path still writes param_scale_vec, which GradientScaler consumes.
